shortLoadAssumption.note: The original failed sample did not retain its full command distribution, so its exact cause is not reconstructed. An unchanged-assertion diagnostic rerun passed; inspection separately found initial scheduling and terminal pacing defects in the runner.

retainedFailures.runnerCorrection: Every scheduled client attempts an initial command; the runner stops rather than bursting when the next paced slot reaches the deadline. Gameplay smoke checks accepted commands of any valid type and their aggregate count; a movement smoke bound detects terminal bursts.

verified: Only one search/revival/boarding interaction per operator.
Movement, damage, elimination and another gameplay action cancel and release claims/reservations immediately.
Looking, stationary keepalives, pings and repeating the current search preserve its timer.
Downed/historical parallel claims cannot open multiple containers.
Rejected requests, failed checkpoints and replayed older receipts preserve the correct current interaction.
Vault unlock payment rolls back with failed writes and remains spent exactly once across interrupted searches.
Two authenticated browser contexts verify rejected contested searches, immediate claim reuse, exactly one pickup owner, action interruption and restartable boarding while the rival raid continues.
limitations: Loopback application-level delay/loss is not real WAN, physical-device or multi-hour testing.
